name: Bangladesh Mother & Baby Care Ecosystem (মা ও শিশু সুরক্ষা ও কমিউনিটি)
description: All-in-one platform for Bangladeshi mothers: EPI vaccine tracker (birth to 15m), mother's baby future savings bank, mothers' social community feed, WHO child growth & milestone tracker, baby weaning recipes & nutrition chart, emergency blood appeals, and milestone scrapbook.
